tools.name: canvas_apply
tools.description: Stage a complete new CanvasSpec revision with explicit bindings and optional backend source. The base digest is compare-and-swap checked; applying never activates or executes the revision.

input_schema.description: Stage a complete new CanvasSpec revision with explicit bindings and optional backend source. The base digest is compare-and-swap checked; applying never activates or executes the revision.

backend.description: Optional externally authored Python source files for a backend. The common Package compiler validates and admits them; source is never returned by Canvas tools.

workItems.description:
Compiler-owned capability declaration; never an execution grant.

Optional accepts zero or one explicit input context; required-input requires
an exact input; consumer permits queue claim; producer has no input context
and may create outputs. None never manufactures a synthetic input.
workItems.title: WorkItemDeclaration

bindings.description: Explicit logical binding targets. Provide only targets authorized for this app.

expectedBase.description: Latest revision digest used as the optimistic edit base; null is valid only before a first revision exists.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen stable key for retrying this mutation with identical input.

spec.description: Complete declarative CanvasSpec for the app UI. Use schemaVersion, title, visibility, bindingIds, and root. It contains logical binding labels only; it never contains Package references, results, credentials, or executable code.
spec.title: CanvasSpec

tools.name: canvas_create
tools.description: Create a useful, unpublished Canvas draft. The returned authored spec can be edited and applied; creation never activates it.

input_schema.description: Create a useful, unpublished Canvas draft. The returned authored spec can be edited and applied; creation never activates it.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen stable key for retrying this mutation with identical input.

title.description: Optional title for a new unpublished Canvas. An empty title is rejected.

tools.name: canvas_get
tools.description: Read the authorized app's latest authored CanvasSpec or one exact revision. The response omits private binding targets and backend source.

input_schema.description: Read the authorized app's latest authored CanvasSpec or one exact revision. The response omits private binding targets and backend source.

revisionId.description: Optional exact immutable revision digest. Omit or pass null for the latest staged revision.

tools.name: canvas_inspect
tools.description: Inspect authorized immutable revision history and identify the active revision. Each returned revision includes its authored CanvasSpec, not private binding targets or source.

input_schema.description: Inspect authorized immutable revision history and identify the active revision. Each returned revision includes its authored CanvasSpec, not private binding targets or source.

tools.name: canvas_open
tools.description: Open the app library without changing state.

tools.name: canvas_preview
tools.description: Validate and preview a CanvasSpec, binding map, and optional backend input without compilation, persistence, activation, or Run admission.

input_schema.description: Validate and preview a CanvasSpec, binding map, and optional backend input without compilation, persistence, activation, or Run admission.

backend.description: Optional externally authored Python source files for a backend. The common Package compiler validates and admits them; source is never returned by Canvas tools.

workItems.description:
Compiler-owned capability declaration; never an execution grant.

Optional accepts zero or one explicit input context; required-input requires
an exact input; consumer permits queue claim; producer has no input context
and may create outputs. None never manufactures a synthetic input.
workItems.title: WorkItemDeclaration

bindings.description: Explicit logical binding targets. Provide only targets authorized for this app.

spec.description: Complete declarative CanvasSpec for the app UI. Use schemaVersion, title, visibility, bindingIds, and root. It contains logical binding labels only; it never contains Package references, results, credentials, or executable code.
spec.title: CanvasSpec

tools.name: canvas_release
tools.description: Explicitly activate one validated draft revision or roll back to one historical revision, using the expected active digest for compare-and-swap. This does not create a Run.

input_schema.description: Explicitly activate one validated draft revision or roll back to one historical revision, using the expected active digest for compare-and-swap. This does not create a Run.

candidateRevision.description: Exact validated draft revision to activate; provide exactly one of candidateRevision or rollbackTo.

expectedActive.description: Current active revision digest for compare-and-swap activation; null only when no revision is active.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen stable key for retrying this mutation with identical input.

rollbackTo.description: Exact historical revision to restore; provide exactly one of candidateRevision or rollbackTo.
